judge.rationale: The candidate Appears to have stopped after the TDD test-writing phase without actually implementing the production fix. Specifically, `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and `CHANGELOG.md` are completely untouched in the candidate diff. As a result, the newly added acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/onErrorRejection.acceptance.test.ts` will fail because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error`. The candidate did update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and wrote valid failing tests, and left `.lore/dod.md` in the tree, but missed the core implementation and changelog entries required by the ticket.
